paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter with spin-based amplifiers
coupling_convention: g_aNN (axion-nucleon derivative coupling) in GeV^-1, exactly as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 4b
notes: Jiang et al. (arXiv:2102.01448) 129Xe-87Rb spin-based amplifier search for ALP-nucleon coupling gaNN over 8.3 feV to 744 feV (2-180 Hz). Explicit numerical limits in text: |gaNN| < 2.9e-9 GeV^-1 at 67.5 feV (5-hour data, 95% CL) and |gaNN| < 3.5e-9 GeV^-1 at 82.05 feV (100-s data, 95% CL). Full exclusion curve is only in Fig. 4b (not extractable as table). 129Xe nuclear spin is neutron-dominated, so AxionNeutron chosen over AxionProton; paper labels it generically 'nucleon'. Standard halo model with rho = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 and v ~ 1e-3 c assumed. Paper also constrains dark photon dEDM/dMDM and quadratic couplings (not extracted here). 3He-K projections (~1e-13 GeV^-1) are future sensitivity, not included.
